23.constraint: Use this French-blue clean straight jean once only for Spring/Fall Casual Everyday, Campus, Travel, Weekend, daytime Date Night or creative casual use. Pair with a regular or controlled-relaxed cream, ecru, white, soft-pink, rust, sage or chocolate top and low-profile off-white, tan or brown footwear; never use the paler wash, a skinny top, another oversized garment, double denim, bulky trainers, Sports/Workout, formal evening styling, or any Wedding/Wedding Guest use.

rejectionGroups.reason: These tops are dominated by oversized graphics, cartoons, graffiti, slogans, pseudo-brand marks, gothic or medieval costume details, shiny fabric or uncontrolled hoodie volume and cannot support a clean modern Zara-led wardrobe.
These product-only black slim bottoms lack reliable on-body proof through the rise, thigh, knee and shoe break and are too generic or narrow to pass the silhouette gate.

These jeans are visibly skinny, thigh-clinging, ankle-narrow or dated by acid and contrast washing; close review confirmed that card 27 remains substantially slimmer and busier than the approved straight jean.
These cargos are product-only or visibly wide, heavily pocketed, puddled, shiny, gimmick-led or insufficiently proven and fail the controlled modern trouser gate.
The plush khaki drawstring trouser is too cropped, cuffed and loose through the leg to serve as a versatile clean utility bottom.
These below-knee floral or distressed camouflage cargo shorts are long, novelty-led and visually dated.
The palm-tree trouser is a novelty set component with an uncontrolled wide, puddled line and cannot enter the single-product styling pool.

qaSummary: 40 identities and all 140 recorded color images loaded for full visual review.
1 bottom accepted in one exact color after close inspection of three variants across the only two plausible jean identities: a French-blue clean straight jean with controlled ease and one shoe break.
39 rejected: every top failed, and the remaining bottoms were skinny, wide, puddled, cargo-heavy, novelty-led or insufficiently proven.
The selected identity, variant and image have zero collision with every prior accepted or conditional item.
